announcements.title: Main Event Planning Meeting
announcements.descriptionMdx:
Mandatory meeting for all members on **May 25th at 3:30 PM** in the Auditorium to discuss final logistics for the main event.

- Bring your volunteer shirt
- Be ready to confirm your shift
- Check the sign-in table when you arrive
